findings.title: Authentication Skip Button Still Present
findings.evidence: Button with text 'Continue Without Signing In →' allows users to bypass authentication by calling setShowAuthPrompt(false)
findings.requirement: Users cannot skip authentication (Phase 1 plan, Fix 1)
findings.userImpact: Users can skip authentication and never sync data to cloud, defeating mandatory auth requirement for production deployment
findings.correction: Remove lines 54-66 from src/app/page.tsx (skip button and explanatory text about local-only mode). Auth gate should be mandatory with only Google OAuth and Magic Link options.
